description: This file defines and registers random number generator (RNG) primitives and higher-order operators for PyTorch, including functions for Philox RNG, RNG state management, and graph-safe RNG operations.

classes.name: HigherOrderOperator
classes.description: A class representing higher-order operators in PyTorch, used for managing complex operator behaviors and dispatching.

methods.name: throw_on_non_cuda
methods.description: Raises an error if attempting to functionalize a non-CUDA RNG operator, indicating unsupported device type.

methods.name: register_rng_prim
methods.description: Registers a custom RNG primitive operation with associated metadata and documentation.

methods.name: philox_rand_offset_meta
methods.description: Returns a tensor-like object representing the offset for Philox RNG based on shape.

methods.name: philox_rand_offset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for Philox RNG based on the shape, device properties, and block configuration.

methods.name: register_philox_rand
methods.description: Registers the Philox RNG primitive with its schema, implementation, and documentation.

methods.name: get_device
methods.description: Determines the device type ('cuda', 'cpu', etc.) from function arguments and keyword arguments.

methods.name: register_run_and_save_rng_state_op
methods.description: Creates and registers an operator to run and save RNG state across different dispatch keys.

methods.name: register_run_with_rng_state_op
methods.description: Creates and registers an operator to run code with a specified RNG state.

methods.name: register_graphsafe_run_with_rng_state_op
methods.description: Creates and registers a graph-safe version of the run_with_rng_state operator.
